name: Claremont Landscape Garden, Esher
summary: This National Trust garden is an important surviving 18th-century landscape, arranged around a lake and amphitheatre, combining history and scenery with family play areas so adults can enjoy the garden while children stay active.
reasonToVisit: An 18th-century National Trust landscape garden with a lake, amphitheatre and play areas
planningDetail: National Trust membership or admission applies; check current opening times
